title: The Cipher of the Green Zone Anew
author: S. M. Amberdale
blurb: Cyrus Crane, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, works cases no one wants attributed. But when a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must burn the network that did the training before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
